# hiok_key_vault (Resource)

A key vault holding secrets, keys and certificates, replicated to the regions you choose. Destroying this resource soft-deletes the vault; its contents stay recoverable until the retention window ends.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 3-63 characters of lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. It becomes part of the vault's URI, so it has to be a valid DNS label.

### Optional

- `allowed_cidrs` (List of String) Addresses permitted to reach a network-restricted vault.
- `primary_region` (String) Region that answers reads and writes. Defaults to the provider's first region.
- `purge_protection` (Boolean) Prevents an early purge. This can be switched on but never off, so changing it back to false will be rejected by the API.
- `regions` (List of String) Regions holding a replica. The primary is included automatically.
- `soft_delete_retention_days` (Number) How long a deleted vault stays recoverable. Clamped to 7-365.
- `vnet_id` (String) Restrict the vault to a virtual network. Leave unset for a vault reachable wherever the caller can authenticate — both are the same plan.
- `vnet_name` (String) Name of that virtual network.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `item_count` (Number)
- `network_restricted` (Boolean)
- `status` (String)
- `vault_uri` (String) Endpoint applications address the vault by.
